_source: energy_osx_banner_final_pricing_intelligence.html, 12-07-2026, the decided standard (Chris, 06-10-2026). KB_GROUP.md 7.4. Every number here is read off that drawing. No renderer may type a number of its own.
_units: px unless stated. em for letter-spacing. unitless for line-height and weight.
_sizes_are_fixed: The drawing's sizes ARE the design at any width: the box reflows, the type does not. An earlier build scaled every size by a multiplier derived from a 1440px reference - numbers that are nowhere in the drawing - which made the banner shrink in a narrow column instead of matching it.
_additions_not_in_the_drawing: stack_below, stack_gap and stack_padding_top. The drawing is one width and says nothing about narrow containers. Below stack_below the two zones stop fitting side by side, so the app zone moves underneath. Chris to confirm or replace.

headline._break: The strapline breaks BEFORE the joiner word, giving 'The operating layer' / 'for energy intelligence'. The 12-07-2026 drawing breaks AFTER it ('The operating layer for' / 'energy intelligence'); Chris chose this on 06-10-2026. Recorded here so both renderers break identically and nobody re-derives it from the drawing.
